name: Maryland Medical Devices
old_description: *Maryland Medical Devices* is dedicated to the distribution of high quality  medical devices developed specifically for the orthopedic segment of healthcare.
about:
Maryland Medical Devices, based in Crofton, Maryland, was founded in 2010 as a privately held company. The firm operates from a suite on Espey Court and focuses exclusively on the orthopedic implant market.

The company distributes and markets orthopedic products, specializing in total joint arthroplasty, sports medicine, and intramedullary fixation devices for minimally invasive surgical procedures. It does not manufacture its own devices; instead, it relies on manufacturing partners to develop solutions that are less invasive, more cost effective, and reduce operating-room time. Product lines referenced include the Apex Knee, Trauma, and Gallileo systems.

Maryland Medical Devices serves the orthopedic segment of healthcare, selling to surgeons, hospitals, and sales agents within the orthopedic community. Its management team brings combined experience across all aspects of the orthopedic market, and the company emphasizes education for both its sales agents and clinical customers.

The company states that its differentiation lies in a commitment to excellence, high-quality products and service, and a leadership role in education. It builds on strong customer relationships and manufacturer expertise to improve every aspect of its business, aiming to deliver precise, reproducible surgical solutions without compromise to the patient.
